description: This file defines utility functions for resolving states related to memory vectors, FTS (possibly a feature toggle), and memory cache, including functions that determine the tone and state based on input object properties.

methods.name: export function resolveMemoryVectorState(vector: { enabled: boolean; available?: boolean }): { resolveMemoryVectorState
methods.description: Determines the tone and state ('ready', 'unavailable', 'disabled', 'unknown') of a memory vector based on its enabled and available flags.

methods.name: export function resolveMemoryFtsState(fts: { enabled: boolean; available: boolean }): { resolveMemoryFtsState
methods.description: Determines the tone and state ('ready', 'unavailable', 'disabled') of the FTS feature based on enabled and available flags.

methods.name: export function resolveMemoryCacheSummary(cache: { enabled: boolean; entries?: number }): { resolveMemoryCacheSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the memory cache state, including tone and a descriptive text that indicates whether cache is on or off, and its entries if available.

methods.name: export function resolveMemoryCacheState(cache: { enabled: boolean }): { resolveMemoryCacheState
methods.description: Determines whether the memory cache is enabled or disabled, returning the corresponding tone and state.
